annotations.title: Plan the sourcing of a prototype

description: Turn a product description into a sourcing plan for a prototype or first batch: parts split into make (process, material, what a factory needs, matched manufacturers) and buy (module class, where such parts come from), integration steps, gaps and assumptions. Read-only, needs no e-mail; use it before create_rfq when the user has a product rather than a single part. States no prices or lead times.

description.description: What the product is, what it does, its size, which parts or prototypes already exist (at least 20 characters)

quantity.description: Target quantity for the first batch (default 10)

name: plan_prototype
title: Plan the sourcing of a prototype
